input.command:
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; python - <<'EOF'
import os, tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=".")
os.mkdir(d + "/sub")
def w(n, s): open(os.path.join(d, n), "w").write(s)
w("a.conf", "a=1\n@include sub/b.conf\nc=3\n")
w("sub/b.conf", "a=2\nc=2\n@include ../d.conf\n")
w("d.conf", "e=5\n")
w("x.conf", "@include y.conf\n"); w("y.conf", "@include x.conf\n"); w("m.conf", "@include nope\n")
c = load(d + "/a.conf"); print(vars(c))
print(vars(load("examples/service.conf")))
for f in ("x", "m"):
    try: load(d + "/%s.conf" % f)
    except ConfigError as e: print("ok", e)
import shutil; shutil.rmtree(d)
EOF
